meta.name: conventional-commits
meta.description: Guide for writing conventional commit messages. Use when committing changes, writing commit messages, or reviewing commit history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出规范化的 Git 提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望团队提交信息格式统一
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want consistent commit messages across your team

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写符合 Conventional Commits 格式的提交消息，强制使用 type(scope): verb subject 单行格式，推荐精准的动作动词，避免弱动词，并确保每个提交只包含一个意图。
howto.when: 当你要求写提交消息、审查提交历史，或在提交变更时，Claude 会触发并遵循此规范。

say.text: 审查这个提交消息是否符合Conventional Commits格式。
say.note: Claude 检查格式并指出问题。

say.text: 将这段代码变更拆分成多个聚焦的commit。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you write commit messages conforming to the Conventional Commits format. It enforces a one-line pattern: <type>(<scope>): <verb><subject>, recommends precise action verbs, avoids weak verbs, and ensures each commit has one intention.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for commit messages, review commit history, or when making commits.

say_en.text: Write a feat commit with scope gov and verb introduce.
say_en.note: Claude generates a proper commit line.

say_en.text: Review this commit message for Conventional Commits compliance.
Split these changes into multiple focused commits.
